# ”Svårt att fånga fallande knivar”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon opened on a defensive note after the Stockholm exchange's worst week since April. The hosts pointed to rising oil, Middle East escalation, a possible US ban on diesel exports and rate jitters, while noting that Q3 as a whole held up better than feared. The company discussion was mostly negative: Nike slumped after its report, Volvo Cars hit all-time lows and Traton warned of weak earnings. Brighter spots were the Mattel bid rumour, Dometic winning its earn-out dispute, new Skanska orders and Volvo as a possible watchlist idea.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ NKE — Nike | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Weak Q1 and lower guidance, sales still falling, China -26%, unclear turnaround. Host calls it catching falling knives.

#### Reasoning

Host Nike McKeebes sees no clear turnaround case: sales keep falling, China and Europe are weak, there are cost cuts and the CEO's strategy shift back to wholesale is still unproven. Colleague Lundgren thinks a turnaround could come but says it is likely too early. The stock is down over 70% in 5 years and fell 9% after the report. Only positives: the US market was slightly better than expected and inventory levels are moving the right way.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales growth returns
- if China inventory clears and sales stabilise
- if wholesale rebuild shows clear traction

> *"Och det tycker jag verkligen att det är svårt att falla fallande knivar. Och just nu får vi väl säga att Nike swooshen bara pekar rakt ner i källaren."*

---

### 🟠 VOLV-B — Volvo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Has traded weakly to below 320 SEK; the order pickup seen at Traton/Scania suggests Volvo's order intake may also improve. Host sees a few tens of kronor of upside by year end.

#### Reasoning

A host linked Traton's pre-close comment that truck order intake picked up in recent weeks to Volvo, which has been weak over late summer. If orders accelerate, the stock could recover a few tens of kronor before year end. This is a radar idea, not an explicit buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Volvo Q3 order intake stays weak
- if truck demand indicators deteriorate

> *"det kan vara värd att ha på radarn. Den borde kunna ha några tior i sig innan året är slut."*
